There was an African American woman and an African American man who both spoke to the principal about their children being bullied. The African American woman yelled at the principal for the lack of help the school was providing, while the African American man asked what could be done to improve the situation. Which person spoke calmly to the principal?
A. The African American man
B. The African American woman
C. Not known
